Let me run the command.

The command output will be long, but I just need to run it. The output will be truncated. Let me run it.

Note: I should produce output only "ok" after. Let me run the command.

I should probably not use run_in_background. Let me just run it with a timeout.

3000 lines of output — the tool truncates to tail. That's fine.

After running, reply with "ok" only. No extra text.

input.command: 1..3000 | ForEach-Object { "line $_ of padding text to make output long" }
